name: AutoFilter
description: Represents autofiltering for the specified worksheet.
example:
Dim w As Worksheet
Dim filterArray()
Dim currentFiltRange As String

Sub ChangeFilters()

Set w = Worksheets("Crew")
With w.AutoFilter
 currentFiltRange = .Range.Address
 With .Filters
 ReDim filterArray(1 To .Count, 1 To 3)
 For f = 1 To .Count
 With .Item(f)
 If .On Then
 filterArray(f, 1) = .Criteria1
 If .Operator Then
 filterArray(f, 2) = .Operator
 filterArray(f, 3) = .Criteria2
 End If
 End If
 End With
 Next
 End With
End With

w.AutoFilterMode = False
w.Range("A1").AutoFilter field:=1, Criteria1:="S"

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range to which the specified AutoFilter applies.

properties.name: Filters
properties.description: Returns a Filters collection that represents all the filters in an autofiltered range. Read-only.

properties.name: FilterMode
properties.description: Returns True if the worksheet is in the AutoFilter filter mode. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: Sort
properties.description: Gets the sort column or columns, and sort order for the AutoFilter collection.

methods.name: ShowAllData
methods.description: Displays all the data returned by the AutoFilter object.
